sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Correct the residual-stability unit IRI: qudt:UNITLESS currently expands to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/UNITLESS, but the canonical recommended unit is http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS; use the correct QUDT vocabulary namespace (for example, a separate unit prefix). Also remove the unconditional minCount 1 requirement on hasLoadingConditionResultEvidence unless evidence is explicitly required by the dependency contract; evidenceTerms is empty, so this would invent a mandatory evidence artifact rather than merely encoding the declared readiness structure.
